title: The app is great but it’s too expensive
body:
The app is intuitive, the learning center is great for reminders and I’m enjoying having digitized and available anywhere the tools that James Clear previously shared with the PDFs. 
However, the pricing point is too high for the scope that the app covers. I won’t be able to continue using it if this doesn’t change. 

My partner also loves the book and the methods and was excited about the app coming out - then in his words  
“I saw the pricing, and did not want to use it. I know if I invest my time in it, I am more likely to keep using it. But because it is so expensive, I do not want to commit my time to it.”
